name: The Social Laboratory
description: An evaluation framework using multi-agent debate to measure emergent social and cognitive behaviors of LLM-based agents with distinct personas and incentives, supervised by an LLM moderator. It quantifies consensus, psychometric profiles, and the influence of moderator personas in interactive multi-agent settings.
reputation: A recent research framework with limited adoption so far, mainly of interest for studying multi-agent social behavior rather than standard benchmark leaderboards.
notes: Focuses on multi-agent debate with LLMs, measuring emergent social behaviors and psychometric profiles; introduces new psychometric and semantic metrics.
